Module gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core

Package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library

package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library
Built-in Metapath functions based on the XPath 3.1 specification. Any XPath functions that operate on an underlying XML document model (XDM) have been adapted to work with an underlying Metaschema module-base model instead.

The MpRecurseDepth functions are new Metapath functions that are not present in XPath 3.1.
